correctness.rationale: The allowable changes form K_{2,2}, and summing alternating runs, including empty and odd-length run lists, gives (1+A)(1+B)/(1-AB). The positive pole is simple with amplitude 1/(rho H'(rho)). At |z|=rho a pole requires equality in both triangle inequalities. Comparing each length-one term with its length-two and length-three powers forces each basic phase to be 1. The balance-only slice therefore has just one phase. In the full torus the x and y angles are binary, and for each combination there are two z angles with the v angle determined: eight saddle points in all. Their factors z^(-n) coincide positively for 4|n. Differentiating log(AB)=0 with respect to the Fourier angles gives zero first derivative and curvature equal to pair-run covariance divided by 2 mu: diag(s,s,t). Here the independence of lengths and signs gives covariance diag(nu,nu,2(nu-mu^2)) for one pair. Simplicity and compactness allow uniform pole extraction on small neighborhoods and a strictly larger radius off them. This gives the stated n^(-1/2) and n^(-3/2) Gaussian prefactors. The letter/run-length automaton is strongly connected with 2- and 3-cycles; its letter symmetries give tilted Perron slope 1/4, yielding exponential suppression for a fixed sub-quarter quota, even after balance or terminal restriction. For the mirror, the last run must be a singleton before doubling at the seam; the integer minimum-content inequalities reduce exactly to the half-word and the unmarked terminal numerator changes the amplitude by 2 rho. Exactly a quarter forces equal counts and 4|n; above a quarter no positive lengths qualify. There is no asserted reflected asymptotic at the boundary. Independent finite corroboration: enumerate by complete runs, starting one state (length j, final letter a, count vector j e_a) for each a and j=1,2,3. Append either adjacent cycle letter in runs j=1,2,3 and add multiplicities to the resulting full count-vector state; for the length-24 mirror count require the last append to have j=1. Exact counts at linear length 48 are 31056472857623585226752, 1928147653129777177600, 1899989961206244002236, 98266297652879155168 for local, balanced, 10 percent and equal-content, respectively; mirror 10 percent gives 11236189644. The archived position-state checker was inspected, not executed. Finite evidence does not establish the asymptotics.
